source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of looping constructs (PDF 44).

blocks.text: Loops kisi kaam ko baar baar dohrate hain, is se code efficient (kam mehnat mein zyada kaam) aur parhne mein aasan hota hai. Python mein loops ki do bari types hain: while loop aur for loop.

blocks.prompt: Python ke do bare loops bataiye.
blocks.explanation: while loop (jab tak condition True rahe, dohrata hai) aur for loop (sequence ki har cheez ke liye dohrata hai).

items: Do loops: while (condition True rehne tak) aur for (sequence par).
